strings.zh: 茜罗娜『我是茜罗娜,{NEWLINE}是精灵训练师。{SCROLL}来到这个{VAR:FF00:1}神都遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}{NEWLINE}使我想起了{CLEAR}自己的家乡,新奥地区。{SCROLL}一开始还以为这里也是像新奥那样{CLEAR}常年被冰雪所覆盖。{SCROLL}但事实并非如此。{SCROLL}远古时期⋯⋯{NEWLINE}有一批新奥地区人们{CLEAR}移居到这片土地。{SCROLL}他们思念家乡,{NEWLINE}于是就在这里建造了神殿。{SCROLL}那就是{VAR:FF00:1}神都遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}⋯⋯{SCROLL}

Abra should be able to take you{CLEAR}where you come from.

strings.zh: 远古的人们得到精灵的生命,{CLEAR}同时,也将自己的生命托付⋯⋯{CLEAR}与之相应,{CLEAR}人们与精灵建立起了{CLEAR}比现在更为深厚的羁绊。{SCROLL}人们的一举一动{NEWLINE}都与精灵的力量息息相关,{CLEAR}世界各地都流传着{CLEAR}相关的神话和传说。{SCROLL}这片土地上的古代遗迹把{NEWLINE}城都的{VAR:FF00:1}阿鲁夫遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}与{CLEAR}新奥的{VAR:FF00:1}枪之柱{VAR:FF00:0}{CLEAR}{VAR:FF00:1}{VAR:FF00:0}两者的传说{CLEAR}都继承了下来⋯⋯{SCROLL}即是说,在远古时期的这片土地上{NEWLINE}城都的人们与{CLEAR}新奥的人们是{CLEAR}有过交集的。
strings.en: People of ancient times received life{NEWLINE}from Pokémon, and in turn entrusted{CLEAR}their own lives to them... In this{CLEAR}way, people and Pokémon built bonds{CLEAR}far deeper than those of today.{SCROLL}Everything people did was closely{NEWLINE}tied to the power of Pokémon, and{CLEAR}myths and legends about it are{CLEAR}handed down all over the world.{SCROLL}The ancient ruins in this land carry{NEWLINE}on the legends of both Johto’s {VAR:FF00:1}Ruins{CLEAR}of Alph{VAR:FF00:0} and Sinnoh’s {VAR:FF00:1}Spear Pillar{VAR:FF00:0}{VAR:FF00:1}{VAR:FF00:0}...{SCROLL}In other words, in ancient times,{NEWLINE}the people of Johto and the{CLEAR}people of Sinnoh met in this land.
